moeObjectiveLeads.text: Add, subtract, multiply and divide decimal.
Use set builder notation to describe sets.
Use the power of set method to determine numbers of sets.

findings.issue: Instruction assumes prerequisites it never checks.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add a short diagnostic per prerequisite with a stated route for learners who lack it.

findings.evidence: no worked-example section or structured workedExamples
findings.issue: Learners never see the method modelled before practising it.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add at least two worked examples that fade support (Track B).

findings.issue: Common errors are neither taught against nor anticipated.
findings.proposedCorrection: Catalogue the objective's misconceptions and teach against each (Track A).

findings.evidence: no item carries response-specific feedback or a misconception-mapped distractor
findings.issue: Wrong answers cannot be diagnosed or corrected by cause.
findings.proposedCorrection: Map each distractor or response pattern to a catalogued misconception with corrective feedback.

findings.evidence: no explain/justify/compare prompt in independent work or assessment
findings.issue: Learners are never asked to produce reasoning, only answers.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add a constructed-response reasoning or performance task at scaffold NONE scored by a rubric.

findings.evidence: no assessment questions found in body or structured fields
findings.issue: Nothing checks whether learners met the objectives.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add an independent end-of-lesson demonstration covering every objective.

findings.evidence: Answer Key:: 1. 7 is in the hundredths place (0.07). 2. 3 is in the tenths place (0.3). 3. 6 is in the tenths place (0.6). 4. 2 is in the o…
findings.issue: Answers sit in the learner-facing text, so assessment evidence is not independent.
findings.proposedCorrection: Move keys to the protected reviewer/teacher projection; never deliver them to learners.

findings.evidence: no delayed or spaced retrieval task
findings.issue: Nothing checks whether learning lasts beyond the lesson.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add a retention blueprint: retrieval items for each mastery objective at ≥7 days (LM-ASM-3).

findings.evidence: no task marked as a new context, representation or genre
findings.issue: Learners are only tested in rehearsed contexts, so transfer is unknown.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add an unscaffolded transfer task in a context the lesson did not rehearse (GE-TRN-1).

findings.evidence: 1 lab link(s), no offline or paper alternative
findings.issue: Learners without a device or connection lose the lab's objective.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add an objective-preserving paper or text walkthrough fallback.

findings.evidence: 1 code(s) not in the MOE structured source, e.g. LR-MATH-G4_6-02 (method: keyword)
findings.issue: Alignment codes are LiberiaLearn-invented labels, not MOE objectives; they must not be presented as MOE requirements.
findings.proposedCorrection: Map each objective to a structured MOE objective id with source page, reviewed by a curriculum owner; lexical leads are attached to this audit.

findings.issue: Ready learners have nowhere to go beyond the objective.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add an optional, non-gating extension clearly labelled as beyond grade scope.
